A '''city''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gerrard V]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] led part of a [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] unit to the [[City/Legends|city]]. After being attacked by the [[128th TIE Interceptor Squadron]], Antilles had to contact [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] forces to help them. The Rogues managed to defeat the 128th.
